clue.text: Captured transmission of water piped round bend

indicators.note: water sent round a bend is diverted, so the letters of the two words are routed into a new order

explanation.surface: A plumbing description: water carried through pipes around a curve.
explanation.walkthrough: The ten letters of 'water piped' are rearranged; 'of' just links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A bugged phone call has its signal secretly intercepted, which is a transmission that has been listened in on and recorded.

clue.text: Gut feeling regularly affected by this

definitions.text: Gut feeling regularly affected by this

indicators.note: affected here means altered or disturbed, telling us to rearrange the letters
regularly means taking every other letter of feeling, here the second, fourth and sixth

explanation.surface: Someone notices their stomach is often upset by something in their food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes ELN from feeling; 'affected' rearranges GUT plus ELN. The whole clue also describes the protein that upsets the guts of coeliacs.
explanation.definitionFit: This wheat protein is what troubles the digestion of people with coeliac disease, so the gut reacts to it.

clue.text: Add up round figure and constant

parts.note: a ring is a circular shape, a round figure
constant in the sense of loyal or faithful means true

explanation.surface: An arithmetic instruction: total things, round the result and add a constant.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases are idioms for a story being plausible or making sense when you consider it.

clue.text: I take leading role describing Hollywood's first goddess

indicators.note: describing in its old sense of drawing around, so the outer letters go round the inner one

parts.note: to star is to play the lead part

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of Hollywood

explanation.surface: An actor boasts of starring in a Hollywood film as a goddess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' means drawing a line round, so I STAR goes round the H from 'Hollywood's first'.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the Babylonian deity of love and war, a figure from Mesopotamian mythology.

clue.text: Bellyache is condition that's not terminal

indicators.note: not terminal means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a complaint is an illness or medical condition

explanation.surface: A doctor reassures that a stomach upset is a condition that won't kill you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not terminal' plays on the medical sense of a fatal illness, but it cuts the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To bellyache is a slangy verb for grumbling or moaning about something.

clue.text: Puppy scratches head servant

indicators.note: scratching the head here means removing the first letter

parts.note: a whelp is a young dog

explanation.surface: A dog scratches the head of the household servant.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic worker is often called the help, as in hired household staff.

clue.text: Dealing with what those who aren't in should be doing

definitions.meaning: handling questions or problems, as a spokesman does

definitions.text: what those who aren't in should be doing
definitions.meaning: in cricket the side not batting (not 'in') is out in the field stopping the ball

explanation.surface: A rebuke to idle players: tackling the job is what anyone not in the house should do.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batting side is 'in'; the other team must catch and stop the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Handling queries is a common figurative sense, and the cricket side not batting spends its time stopping the ball.

clue.text: Trap game under base of oak tree

indicators.note: under places the game below the letter before it in this down entry

parts.note: a gin is a snare for catching animals

indicators.note: in a down clue the base is the bottom letter of oak

parts.note: Go is the Japanese board game

explanation.surface: A snare is set for game beneath an oak tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The maidenhair species is an ancient Chinese tree with fan-shaped leaves.

clue.text: Fireman moving right to end of line

indicators.note: moving signals that one letter is shifted to a new place
to end of says where the shifted letter goes: the final position

parts.note: a stroke is a line drawn with a pen

explanation.surface: A firefighter moves right to the end of a queue.
explanation.walkthrough: The R in STROKE goes to the end of the word. A 'fireman' here is a ship's or engine's boiler-tender, not a firefighter.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who feeds coal into a furnace on a steam train or ship was traditionally called a fireman.

clue.text: Most recent releases ultimately ruin One Direction

indicators.note: releases means lets go of, so letters leave the word

parts.note: the most recent is the newest

indicators.note: ultimately takes the last letter of each of ruin and One

explanation.surface: A grumble that the boy band One Direction's latest records will ruin them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One Direction' looks like the band, but 'One' only gives its last letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the four compass points, the way the sun sets.

clue.text: Twig catching coat of nimble cat-like creature

indicators.note: catching means holding something inside

parts.note: to twig is to understand, to get it

indicators.note: the coat is the outside layer, the first and last letters of nimble

explanation.surface: A branch snags the fur of an agile cat-like animal.
explanation.definitionFit: This small spotted carnivore of Africa and southern Europe resembles a slender cat.

clue.text: Religious leader animated man forsaking you in the Bible?

indicators.note: forsaking means abandoning, so those letters are dropped

parts.note: Popeye is the cartoon sailor
ye is the archaic biblical form of you

explanation.surface: A cartoon character abandons a biblical reader to become a church leader.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bishop of Rome heads the Roman Catholic Church.

clue.text: Gather one working in bed perhaps lacks guts

indicators.note: without its guts means the middle letters are removed

parts.note: someone who tends a flower bed is a gardener

explanation.surface: A lazy worker who stays in bed is said to have no courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' is a flower bed, not a place to sleep; removing the middle two letters leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To collect or amass, as in harvesting grain into a granary.

clue.text: Guy's partner overcomes resistance with bunch of flowers

indicators.note: overcomes here means sits over and around, enclosing the letter

parts.note: a guy's girl is his gal
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
and can mean with, together

explanation.surface: A man's girlfriend wins him over with a bouquet.
explanation.definitionFit: A wreath or festoon of blooms worn or hung as decoration.

clue.text: Heartless girls turned up and put one's nose out of joint

definitions.text: put one's nose out of joint

indicators.note: up in the sense of in turmoil, as in things being all up, signals rearranging
heartless removes the central letter of girls

explanation.surface: Cold-hearted girls arrived and upset someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartless' removes R from girls, leaving GILS; 'up' rearranges GILS plus TURNED. 'turned' looks like the anagram signal but supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to annoy or offend, leaving someone sulky and resentful.

clue.text: Champion wants to drink beer

indicators.note: wants means lacks, so those letters are dropped

parts.note: a champion of a cause is its supporter
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: A sports champion fancies a beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark brown ale, once popular with London market labourers.

clue.text: Proceeds to fix set price

indicators.note: to fix can mean to rig or alter, so the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: A firm moves to fix a set price for its goods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Proceeds' looks like a verb, but it is the noun meaning takings.
explanation.definitionFit: Money taken in by a business is its takings or income.

clue.text: London district where one can drink at home when short of time

parts.note: a bar is a place to get a drink

indicators.note: short of means missing, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: a nest is a home, especially a bird's

explanation.surface: Someone recommends drinking at home in a London area when pressed for time.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a riverside area of south-west London, in the borough of Richmond upon Thames.

clue.text: Knowing quality of knight captured in game by a rook

parts.note: R is the chess notation for rook

indicators.note: captured in means held inside

parts.note: chess is the board game
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A chess commentary: the knight is taken by a rook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just joins the pieces, which go A, R, then the game with the knight inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Being playfully sly or knowing, as with a mischievous look, is this quality.

clue.text: I state "lives must take precedence"

definitions.note: I is the abbreviation for island on maps

indicators.note: taking precedence means coming first, so this piece leads

parts.note: lives means exists, which is is
a land is a nation or state

explanation.surface: A declaration that human lives must come first.
explanation.walkthrough: The single letter 'I' is the definition, as on maps; 'state' looks like a verb but is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: On maps and charts, the abbreviation I or Is stands for a piece of land surrounded by water.

clue.text: Devil put neck out in hell

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the other word

parts.note: Dis is the classical underworld

indicators.note: out means disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The Devil sticks his neck out in hell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Devil' looks like the subject of the sentence but is the definition; Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, used for hell itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Used in exclamations such as 'what the ...!' as a euphemism for the devil.

clue.text: Complete furnishing part of apartment I rented

indicators.note: furnishing means supplying, so the words supply a part of themselves as the answer

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A landlord furnishes a flat for a tenant.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Complete furnishing' as the definition, but the answer means only 'Complete'; 'furnishing part of' signals the extraction.
explanation.definitionFit: Whole or total, with nothing missing, as in an entire collection.

clue.text: Fish stuffed with raw minced chicken

indicators.note: stuffed with means filled by, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: cod is a fish

indicators.note: minced means chopped up, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A recipe: fish filled with raw minced chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chicken' is the definition as a slang term, not the food; 'minced' turns RAW into WAR.
explanation.definitionFit: In slang a chicken is a timid person who lacks courage.

clue.text: Fighting witnessed in European capital

parts.note: war is fighting
saw means witnessed

explanation.surface: Someone saw combat in a European capital.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the capital city of Poland, heavily fought over in the Second World War.

clue.text: Short film about Anglicanism's first primate

indicators.note: about means around, so the outer letters enclose the inner
short means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a film is a thin skin or layer

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of Anglicanism

explanation.surface: A brief documentary about the head of the Anglican church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primate' looks like an archbishop, given Anglicanism, but it is a monkey.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a long-tailed South American monkey, a member of the primate order.

clue.text: State body dismisses dishonourable man

indicators.note: dismisses means sends away, so those letters leave

parts.note: a cadaver is a dead body
a cad is a man who behaves dishonourably

explanation.surface: A governing body sacks a disgraced man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' is the verb meaning declare, not a nation, and 'body' is a corpse, not an organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: To assert or declare something firmly.

clue.text: I want to change old couple

indicators.note: to change means to alter, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: An old married pair, one of whom wants things to change.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for two, as in 'never the ... shall meet'.

clue.text: Currency arbitrarily cut by 50%

indicators.note: cut by fifty percent means keeping only the first half of the word

parts.note: something done arbitrarily is done at random

explanation.surface: A currency devalued by half on a whim.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the money of South Africa.

clue.text: Right to put off drinking up times

indicators.note: drinking up means taking in completely, so the other letter goes inside

parts.note: to deter is to put someone off
X is the multiplication sign, times

explanation.surface: It is right to discourage someone downing drinks repeatedly.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin-derived word for the right-hand side is used in heraldry.

clue.text: Former copper meets national leader once

parts.note: d was the abbreviation for the old British penny, a copper coin before decimalisation in 1971
an Israeli is a national of Israel

explanation.surface: An ex-policeman meets a foreign head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' suggests a police officer, but it is the old British penny, written d.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin was a Victorian Prime Minister of Britain, so a past head of government.
